note: HF.5: Rails `resources` / `resource` blocks nest their children (`/accounts/:account_id/notifications`), `member` / `collection` blocks and `on:` re-root their verbs, symbol verbs name a path segment, and a plural `resources` adds its `/:id` member path unless `only:` / `except:` leave no member action. Before HF.5 (glia 0.5.6, release CLI) the route reader flattened every nested resource to `ANY /api/v1/<r>` and read no symbol verb, so chatwoot's 301 account-scoped client ENDPOINTs had no route to pair (`[http] routes=223 endpoints=334 paired=5`). After (debug CLI on this fixture): `[ruby-routes] composed 12 rails routes under 3 scopes nested=10 member=1 collection=1 id_routes=4` and `[http] routes=12 endpoints=6 paired=6`.
